limitations: This evaluation covers only the eight French target cases in batch 7/16; it cannot establish a decision for all 128 cases.

editorialSafety.rationale: The report protects negotiated decisions, emotional space and autonomy, and explicitly rejects predictive interpretation. The four strength tags remain categorical positive descriptors, especially self-discipline, but the reflection framing makes them acceptable as prompts rather than measured abilities. Percentage and neighbor notes also avoid inferential claims.
